metric_definitions.family_recall: binary attack detection within each attack family
metric_definitions.average_precision: sklearn average_precision_score, not trapezoidal PR AUC
metric_definitions.pooled_unseen_recall: fraction of unseen attack records predicted attack
metric_definitions.macro_attack_family_recall: unweighted mean of supported DoS/Probe/R2L/U2R recall; excludes Normal
metric_definitions.unseen_attack_recall: pooled recall on attack names absent from training
metric_definitions.fit_seconds: estimator fit only; excludes preprocessing and calibration
metric_definitions.predict_seconds: estimator test scoring and thresholding; excludes preprocessing
